scope: Verified league records through 2026 Week 8; 2025 full season and 2026 partial season kept separate

methods.draftPoints: Sum actual regular-season points from players selected by this manager, counted only when starting for original drafting team; exclude post-trade starts and bench points.
methods.peerSurplus: Sum pilot pointsAbovePeerMedian across nonkeeper picks; the peer median is nearby same-position same-year draft rounds. This is descriptive realized draft production, not draft decision causality.
methods.grade2025: Within the ten 2025 managers, rank summed nonkeeper round-and-position peer surplus (13 selections each). Label ranks 1–2 A, 3–4 B, 5–6 C, 7–8 D, 9–10 F. This grade is an observed 2025 return tier only, not a manager skill grade.
methods.grade2026: No full-season letter grade until 2026 completes. Compare only within the same partial-season Week 8 window.
methods.lateRound: Rounds 10–15, with keeper picks excluded from late-round draft-steal rankings.
methods.keeperObserved: Retained player's original-manager starts and points, and difference to observed league same-position starting medians for those weeks.
methods.keeperDecision: True keeper decision/opportunity cost needs the complete eligible roster at keeper lock, keeper cost rules, alternative candidates and their realized/predicted returns; those records have not been verified.
methods.historicalGrades2020to2024: For 2020–2024, rank each year's ten teams using the archived v9 draft-engine realized regular-starter surplus (its original, historical baseline). Label 1–2 A, 3–4 B, 5–6 C, 7–8 D, 9–10 F. This baseline is not the newer 2025 nearby same-position-and-round peer model, so do not compare point surplus or grades directly between eras. These are observed return tiers, not talent evaluation.
methods.keeperRoundSlotProxy: For each 2026 keeper, compare original-team observed starter points to the same round's nonkeeper picks from the verified 2026 draft. This is an ex post realized slot comparison only, NOT a decision-time alternative or true keeper opportunity cost.
methods.managerEvidence: For each manager, the top three and bottom two observed peer-adjusted pick returns are shown with original-manager starter points and credited starts. A weak pick outcome is not proof the draft-day process was poor.

limits: 2025 and 2026 are separate windows; 2026 is incomplete through Week 8 and not a final ranking.
No keeper is counted as a new draft choice for manager draft grade.
Comparisons are against observed same-year round/position peers, not draft-day alternatives.
Original-manager starts exclude points earned on another roster after a trade.
2016–2019 ESPN draft order is recovered but week-by-week player starter points are not certified for comparable draft-value grades.
Manager grades are descriptive return tiers (2025), never inferred management intent or talent skill.
2026 keeper decision/opportunity cost remains unavailable, not zero.
The archived v9 surplus benchmark (2020–2024) differs from the 2025/2026 position-and-round peer median; point values are not cross-model comparable.
2018 ESPN offline draft import is position sorted, so its apparent player order cannot be treated as verified overall pick rank.

requiredEvidence: precise keeper rules and round-cost adjustments
every eligible alternate and deadline cost
keeper selection timestamps and exchanged pick ownership where applicable
comparable pre-draft value expectation if claiming ex ante decision quality
